title: A Reliability Study of Explainable AI for Freight Mode Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.15716v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning models are increasingly used to support freight transportation decisions, but their predictions are rarely accompanied by evidence that the associated explanations can be trusted. In this study we investigate explainable machine learning for classifying shipments as Air/Air Charter or Truck/Ocean using the PEPFAR Supply Chain Management System Delivery History dataset, with 5,964 shipment records and 47 input features after cleaning, where freight cost and pack price are excluded as near-proxies of the transportation mode. We compare three Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) architectures, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and gradient boosting with imbalance-aware metrics and paired significance tests across one hundred random replications. translated_title: 货运模式分类中可解释人工智能的可靠性研究
translated_abstract: 机器学习模型在货运交通决策中的应用日益增多，但其预测往往缺乏能够证明相关解释可信的证据。本研究利用PEPFAR供应链管理系统交付历史数据集（清洗后包含5,964条货运记录和47个输入特征，其中运费和包装价格因近似为运输方式的代理变量而被排除），研究用于将货运方式分类为空运/空运包机或卡车/海运的可解释机器学习方法。我们比较了三种多层感知机（MLP）架构、逻辑回归、随机森林和梯度提升模型，采用类别不平衡感知的评估指标，并跨一百次随机重复实验进行配对显著性检验。随后，我们对解释本身进行评估，包括SHAP特征排名在重训练过程中以及跨模型之间的稳定性，以及SHAP和LIME归因在特征（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 本研究基于PEPFAR货运数据集，系统评估了多种机器学习模型在货运方式分类任务中SHAP与LIME解释的重训练稳定性、跨模型一致性及忠实性，以检验可解释AI的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates the reliability of explainable AI for freight mode classification by assessing the stability and faithfulness of SHAP and LIME explanations across multiple machine learning models and retraining runs on the PEPFAR shipment dataset.
